output.reason: The evidence provides the text of a residual clause stating: “In cases other than those mentioned at paragraph 261(1) and (2) above, pre-payment charges, if any, shall be as per the approved policy of a UCB.” This matches the substantive rule described in the claim. However, the evidence does not support that this is an “RBI rule” (it cites “UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions, 2025”), nor does it independently establish that it is the “current” rule beyond the document reference or how exactly it applies “for this case” other than the brief note about para 261(5) being applicable when para 261(1) and (2) do not. Therefore the claim is only partially supported.
